description: This Java class 'ConvertOrderersToProviders' is a custom Liquibase change that upgrades the database by converting 'orderer' references from user IDs to provider IDs, creating provider accounts for orderers without providers, and updating the 'orders' table accordingly.

classes.name: ConvertOrderersToProviders
classes.description: A custom Liquibase task class that retrieves orderer user IDs, converts them to provider IDs, and updates the database accordingly.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the conversion process by retrieving relevant users and providers, then updating the orders table.

methods.name: getUsersAndProviders
methods.description: Queries the database to get a list of user IDs and their corresponding provider IDs for users who are orderers.

methods.name: convertOrdererToProvider
methods.description: Performs batch updates to replace 'orderer' user IDs with provider IDs in orders, and sets 'orderer' to a default value where null.

methods.name: getConfirmationMessage
methods.description: Returns a confirmation message after successfully completing the conversion.

methods.name: setFileOpener
methods.description: Sets the resource accessor, currently empty.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the database before running the change, currently returns null.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles exceptions by rolling back the transaction and throwing a custom exception.
